baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِّيَشْهَدُوا۟ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ ... فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا۟ ٱلْبَآئِسَ ٱلْفَقِيرَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The purpose clause moves from being present at benefit, through naming the giver over apportioned livestock, to two coordinated imperatives: consume and cause another to eat. Benefit is therefore completed as a visible circulation joining personal receipt to relief of severe need.

activation_trace.role: Presence with direct seeing makes the benefits public and encounterable rather than merely reported.
Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the positive good that the sequence must actually deliver.
An apportioned gift makes the livestock received provision rather than autonomous property.
Literal eating realizes one legitimate destination of the provision.
Causing another to eat opens the provision outward toward a needy recipient.
Constriction of life identifies severe hardship as the condition the food flow is to interrupt.
Material need fixes the outward command on an actual deficit rather than generic generosity.

changed_reading.before: Pilgrims obtain unspecified benefits and separately perform an act of food charity.
changed_reading.after: The benefits become witnessable through one provision circuit whose completion includes both the participants' eating and the distressed poor person's eating.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَذْكُرُوا۟ ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Internal recollection and voiced mention converge on the divine name inside bounded days that are both known and marked. Repetition in a recognizable temporal frame makes memory publicly performable and keeps the provision attached to its giver.

activation_trace.role: Recollection after or against forgetting supplies the inward recovery of the giver.
Mention on the tongue turns recovered memory into audible communal action.
The name functions as explicit designation, attaching the act and provision to God.
Delimited days give the remembrance a repeated and shared temporal container.
A distinguishing mark makes the days findable and collectively recognizable.

changed_reading.before: The verse prescribes saying God's name on calendar dates already known.
changed_reading.after: The known days are a marked public memory-frame in which inward recollection becomes voiced designation over received life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, invoked powers are measured by a harm-benefit polarity and fail that test; their harm is nearer than their benefit and their patronage is condemned. The focus then places actual benefits, apportioned provision, and relief of the distressed under God's name, making the food circuit an enacted contrast to powerless allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Harm as loss contrary to benefit establishes the evaluative polarity for ineffective invocation.
The denied capacity to benefit supplies the negative foil for the focus ayah's concrete benefits.
Nearer harm sharpens the contrast from mere uselessness to counterproductive allegiance.
Remote benefit makes practical beneficence a test rather than an abstract claim.
The formula of blame condemns the failed patron and companion against the focus ayah's distressed recipient.
Actual benefits anchor the contrast back in the focus ayah.
Apportioned provision identifies the effective source behind those benefits.

structural_cues: 22:12-13 explicitly repeat harm and benefit around invocation, while 22:28 joins benefits to God's name, God's provision, and feeding.
The focus recipient described by بائس reverses the earlier بئس verdict from condemning a bad patron to relieving a person in hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical polarity and the later material provision; I infer that the provision circuit functions as an embodied criterion of allegiance. A live alternative is that the two passages only contrast rhetorically without making ritual distribution evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The benefits are practical advantages incidental to pilgrimage.
changed_reading.after: The benefits and their redistribution visibly answer the surah's earlier question of who can truly benefit rather than harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacred place is made equal for resident and outsider, then a public announcement draws people through distant open routes toward it. In that ordered approach, witnessing benefits cannot remain a local privilege: the assembly is produced by open access, and feeding extends its benefit to someone unable to secure a share independently.

activation_trace.role: Equality between two parties makes resident and outsider co-entitled to the sacred place.
Public notification by a call supplies the audible cause of the gathering.
Directed intention toward what is magnified gives the arriving multitude a common destination.
Open mountain routes spatialize access from dispersed origins.
Distance in a deep route makes inclusion costly and geographically broad.
Presence at the destination is the focus ayah's realized answer to the call.
Feeding carries the gathering's access principle into material distribution.

structural_cues: 22:25 establishes equality of resident and outsider; 22:27 summons arrivals from every deep pass; 22:28 states the purpose of their arrival.
The plural لهم sits inside a gathering already widened beyond local residents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equal access, public summons, distant travel, and subsequent feeding; I infer that spatial inclusion governs the benefits' distribution. The alternative is that equality concerns only entry to the sanctuary and does not determine the scope of منافع.

changed_reading.before: Those who manage to arrive witness benefits available to the pilgrim group.
changed_reading.after: The benefits belong to an intentionally opened assembly, and feeding makes equal sacred access materially consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence places benefits in the sacrificial animals only until a named term, after which their due arrival is toward the Ancient House. This bounds use by a deadline and destination, revising benefit from possession into temporary usufruct within an assigned ritual trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The exact recurrence of benefits identifies the focus ayah's gain with a time-limited good.
Naming as designation makes the limiting term appointed rather than accidental.
Arrival or settling at a place gives the animals a terminus beyond interim use.
The coming-due image keeps a live temporal reading alongside the spatial terminus.
The focus ayah's benefits are the model being bounded.
Marked days coordinate the focus act with the later appointed limit.

structural_cues: 22:33 repeats منافع لكم and immediately limits them with إلى أجل مسمى ثم.
The sequence moves from interim benefits to a stated محل at the House.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies benefits, a named limit, and a terminus; I infer a stewardship relation in which use is real but not absolute ownership. Whether محل is primarily the place or time of becoming due remains live, but either reading preserves boundedness.

changed_reading.before: Livestock benefits are possessions enjoyed before sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: Livestock benefits are legitimate but temporary uses held under an appointed deadline and destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim restatement in 22:34 is framed by a rite assigned to every community and by one God, surrender, and receptive lowliness. The form of rite can vary by community, while naming God over received animal life remains an invariant movement from gift to submission.

activation_trace.role: Community as a gathered kind supplies the plurality among which rites are distributed.
Sacrificial offering identifies the concrete domain of the repeated naming clause.
A rite's place and work allow distinct communal forms without dissolving the shared mechanism.
Divine oneness supplies the single addressee across plural ritual communities.
Handing over and relinquishing control gives submission a transfer-shaped role.
Low settled terrain supplies a spatial image for receptive, unexalted posture.
The focus ayah's voiced naming is the invariant action being reframed.
Received apportionment makes surrender responsive to gift rather than self-generated.

structural_cues: 22:34 repeats يذكروا اسم الله على ما رزقهم من بهيمة الأنعام almost exactly from the focus ayah.
The repeated clause is enclosed by لكل أمة ... منسكا and فإلهكم إله واحد فله أسلموا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural communities and rites around an exact shared clause, followed by one God and surrender; I infer that the invariant is the gift-naming-submission mechanism rather than identical ritual form. A live alternative is that every community refers only to a succession of past prescriptions.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives one community a fixed sacrificial formula.
changed_reading.after: The formula exposes a transcommunal invariant: diverse rites become submission when received life is explicitly returned in name to the one giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next characterization pairs two transformations: mention of God moves the heart, and provision received from God moves outward in expenditure. This parallel makes the focus ayah's naming and feeding two coordinated responses rather than a ritual formula followed by unrelated charity.

activation_trace.role: Audible mention supplies the input that reaches beyond the tongue.
Fear felt by the heart is the inward effect of divine mention.
Apportioned gift supplies the material input for the second transformation.
Money or goods going out in expenditure makes received provision leave private custody.
The focus ayah supplies the voiced remembrance whose inward effect is clarified.
Feeding is the focus ayah's concrete mode of outward expenditure.

structural_cues: 22:35 coordinates إذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم with ومما رزقناهم ينفقون in one description of the receptive.
22:28 likewise places ذكر and رزق before the outward imperative أطعموا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two paired clauses; I infer a formal analogy between an inwardly moved heart and outwardly moving provision. They may instead be independent virtues, but their recurrence of focus roots keeps the analogy live.

changed_reading.before: Naming sanctifies the animal, after which feeding is a separate social obligation.
changed_reading.after: Naming and feeding are paired conversions: mention penetrates the heart, while provision exits the hand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacrificial body stands, falls onto its sides, and is routed to self and two recipient types; the next ayah denies that flesh or blood reaches God and says protective God-consciousness does. Material movement is therefore horizontal toward creatures, while the nonmaterial response is what reaches God.

activation_trace.role: The dedicated sacrificial body supplies the material whose route is being traced.
Falling converts the standing sign into available flesh for distribution.
Contented acceptance supplies one socially quiet mode of receiving food.
Asking for food remains a live alternate recipient posture within the same distribution.
Approaching and exposing oneself supplies the second recipient's active access to the food.
Recognition of favor names the intended response to the animal's subjection and sharing.
Repeated attainment explicitly compares what does not reach God with what does.
Literal flesh is excluded from the upward destination and left available for creaturely eating.
Literal blood reinforces the denial of material transfer to God.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the inward orientation that does reach God.
The focus command to eat fixes the flesh's first horizontal destination.
The focus command to feed fixes its second horizontal destination.

structural_cues: 22:36 repeats فكلوا منها وأطعموا from 22:28 after the sacrificial bodies fall.
22:37 immediately negates the arrival of flesh and blood at God, then contrasts them with تقوى.
The recipient pair in 22:36 broadens the focus ayah's single distressed-poor designation without canceling need-directed distribution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily fall, eating and feeding, the negated material arrival, and the positive arrival of تقوى; I supply the horizontal-versus-upward directional model. The live alternative treats تقوى only as an acceptance criterion, though the material non-transfer remains explicit.

changed_reading.before: Feeding disposes charitably of matter after an offering directed to God.
changed_reading.after: The sacrifice reverses material offering: flesh is directed to creatures, while gratitude and protective God-consciousness are what reach God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, divine repelling prevents the demolition of multiple kinds of worship space precisely where God's name is mentioned abundantly. The focus ayah's naming over food is thus one instance of a vulnerable public practice whose spatial conditions require protection.

activation_trace.role: Repelling harm supplies the protective force that keeps public worship possible.
Building collapse names the material threat to spaces of remembrance.
Repeated voiced mention identifies what preserved spaces enable.
The exact divine-name construction links public worship spaces to the focus utterance.
The focus ayah anchors the public-space activation in naming over provision.

structural_cues: 22:40 causally links the repelling of people to the non-demolition of diverse worship spaces.
Those spaces are characterized by abundant mention of the same اسم الله construction used in 22:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected buildings and abundant naming; I infer that the focus naming belongs to a broader public ecology rather than an isolated slaughter formula. The spaces listed may remain institutionally distinct, so this need not homogenize their practices.

changed_reading.before: Mentioning God's name is a momentary formula attached to slaughter.
changed_reading.after: The formula participates in a protected public culture of naming whose material spaces and access can be defended or destroyed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain is delivered from above, receptive earth becomes green, and God is then declared owner of all yet wholly independent. Read against that sequence, livestock provision is one stage in a larger ecological gift chain; humans do not originate it and must relay its edible yield to other dependent creatures.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward supplies the first motion in the ecological provision chain.
Water supplies the material medium by which provision precedes animal and human use.
Soft productive earth receives the water and becomes a provisioning substrate.
Fresh green growth supplies the inferred grazing link toward livestock.
Gentle beneficence characterizes the unobtrusive delivery of the chain.
Divine independence blocks any reading in which God needs the food or animal matter.
The focus ayah names the livestock stage as apportioned gift.
Feeding makes humans a relay rather than the final reservoir of provision.

structural_cues: 22:63 moves from descending water to green earth; 22:64 immediately declares universal ownership and divine independence.
22:28 attributes the livestock to divine provision before assigning its food to human recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain, green earth, livestock provision, feeding, and divine independence; I supply the ecological arrows from growth to grazing animal and from animal to human food. Green earth can remain a general sign rather than a direct causal gloss on the cattle.

changed_reading.before: God gives the participants an animal, from which they share meat.
changed_reading.after: The animal is a middle node in a rain-earth-life-human chain, and feeding keeps dependent life moving while the giver remains independent.

context_deltas.mechanism: God is witness over all earlier in the surah; at the close, the community is named as submitters and assigned to be witnesses over people while holding fast to God. The focus sequence of witnessing benefits and voicing God's name can therefore function as a local enactment of a named community learning public witness through surrendered provision.

activation_trace.role: Divine testimony grounded in knowledge establishes the surah's highest witness frame.
Naming as designation gives the community an explicit identity before its witness assignment.
Surrender as handing over supplies the posture encoded in the community's name.
Messenger testimony and communal testimony turn witness from attendance into public responsibility.
Protective holding supplies the dependence that sustains rather than self-authorizes witness.
Presence at benefits supplies the focus ayah's embodied apprenticeship in witness.
Voicing God's designation pairs naming with the local act of witnessing.

structural_cues: The surah moves from God as شهيد in 22:17 to the messenger as شهيدا and the community as شهداء in 22:78.
22:78 places God's naming of the community before its witness role; 22:28 pairs witnessing with ذكر اسم الله.
The closing commands to prayer, almsgiving, and holding fast preserve the same worship-social-dependence combination found in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated witness and naming constructions; I infer that 22:28 is one formative practice of the closing witness identity. The ending may instead summarize the surah broadly without making this ritual scene its direct training ground.

changed_reading.before: Participants attend the pilgrimage benefits and recite God's name.
changed_reading.after: Their attendance, naming, and redistribution rehearse the identity of a divinely named community charged to become public witnesses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant و س م mapping under the focus root س م و and sets its marking images against the branch of ب ه م as absence of distinguishing marks; that is branch resonance, not the surface syntax's ordinary lexical derivation. It remains anchored in the adjacent focus words اسم, أيام معلومات, and بهيمة, and 22:32 independently supplies a ritual sign. Downstream prose should present it as exploratory ritual semiotics, not translate اسم as brand or بهيمة as unmarked.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱسْمَ ٱللَّهِ فِىٓ أَيَّامٍۢ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ

activation_trace.role: A visible mark that makes something known supplies an exploratory semiotic layer to the divine name.
A marked season that gathers people links name, known days, and public assembly.
A distinguishing guide-mark makes the ritual time legible.
Absence of a distinguishing mark supplies the contrastive raw state of the animal body.
The non-discerning living creature keeps the model attached to actual animal life rather than pure symbolism.
A perceptible ritual marker confirms that animal rites can function as public signs.

changed_reading.before: God's name is pronounced over livestock during known days.
changed_reading.after: Marked speech in marked time makes otherwise indistinct animal life a public sign, whose legibility is completed when its benefit is shared.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the فقار and فاقرة branches resonate inside فقير rather than restricting the adjective to low assets. It remains anchored in the exact focus recipient and is reinforced by بائس as constricted life, but the ordinary need branch is still primary. Downstream prose should say the poor person may be imagined as structurally or back-breakingly afflicted, never replace poverty with spinal injury.

activation_trace.role: Constricted livelihood supplies the ordinary hardship frame.
Articulated vertebrae supply an image of the structure by which a person bears life's load.
A back-breaking calamity deepens need from a monetary shortage into collapsed life-capacity.
Material need constrains the bodily resonance and preserves the adjective's direct social referent.

changed_reading.before: The recipient is poor in the narrow sense of lacking money or food.
changed_reading.after: The recipient is materially needy and may also be heard as someone whose capacity to bear life has been structurally broken by hardship.

strongest_changes: The exact 22:33 recurrence bounds benefits by an appointed term and destination, turning possession into timed stewardship.
The 22:36-37 echo redirects flesh horizontally to creatures while gratitude and protective God-consciousness, not matter, reach God.
The 22:34 near-verbatim restatement places a shared gift-naming-submission mechanism inside plural communal rites.
The closing naming and witness commission in 22:78 turns the focus assembly into a plausible apprenticeship for communal witness.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence separated four motions that the focus alone compresses: gift arrives, naming identifies its source, matter circulates among dependent creatures, and witness becomes public responsibility. The split س م و to و س م inventory also exposed a contained mark-season-sign reading that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The قانع branches preserve both contented reception and asking, so the exact recipient taxonomy in 22:36 remains open.
The link from 22:28's attendance to 22:78's witness commission may be formative rather than directly explanatory.
The ecological chain from green earth to grazing livestock is reader-supplied even though each endpoint is packet-grounded.
The و س م and spinal ف ق ر activations should remain lexical resonances rather than replacement translations.
